svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Step 4 polish 10: the hero rule at 4K and in portrait
svg.text: 10 · The same rule at 4K and in portrait
A crew spotlight with a photo on a 3840 × 2160 screen (drawn at 25 %), and Doors open on the portrait entrance, 1080 × 1920 (drawn at 40 %). Book shots R2, R19, A1, A5.
4K · crew spotlight with a photo (R2)

g.text: Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight

svg.text: At 4K every size doubles: the safe area is 128 px, the headline 256 px, the kicker 88 px,
the body 120 px. The layout is the same picture, only sharper (R2 showed the 1080p sizes
in a corner of the 4K hero). A photo narrower than half the hero is not stretched:
the hero falls back to type without it.
Portrait · Doors open at the entrance (A5)

g.text: Lost and found at the info desk
Find a seat, plug in, have fun

svg.text: Portrait
The hero is the top of the screen, the full
width less 48 px a side and about 1,040 px
tall; the next item and the Wi-Fi sit under it.
The same steps apply: the headline starts at
150 px here because the hero is narrower, and
takes up to three lines.
The event’s name is filled before the first
step is drawn, so the first fire never reads
“Welcome to” on its own (A5, R19).
A screen with no rail (a single wide hero) uses
the full-screen sizes.
